stories.headline: The ECCC: EUR 730 million in cybersecurity grants, paid out slowly, and a mandate that ends in 2029
stories.deck: The European Cybersecurity Competence Centre in Bucharest now manages 224 projects worth EUR 730 million from Digital Europe and Horizon Europe. Its budget peaked in 2024 and falls to about EUR 170 million a year; payments lag behind commitments by more than two years' worth. What comes after 2027 is open: Digital Europe is to merge into a Competitiveness Fund, and the Centre itself is set up only until the end of 2029.
stories.headline_de: Das ECCC: 730 Mio. EUR Fördermittel für Cybersicherheit, langsam ausgezahlt, und ein Mandat, das 2029 endet
stories.deck_de: Das Europäische Kompetenzzentrum für Cybersicherheit in Bukarest betreut inzwischen 224 Projekte über 730 Mio. EUR aus Digitales Europa und Horizont Europa. Sein Haushalt erreichte 2024 den Höchststand und sinkt auf rund 170 Mio. EUR im Jahr; die Zahlungen hinken den Mittelbindungen um mehr als zwei Jahresraten hinterher. Offen ist, was nach 2027 kommt: Digitales Europa soll in einem Wettbewerbsfähigkeitsfonds aufgehen, und das Zentrum selbst ist nur bis Ende 2029 errichtet.

stories.headline: Is ENISA equipped for its tasks? Half its money is temporary, and the Cybersecurity Act 2 would mainly make it permanent
stories.deck: ENISA's own budget has grown little since 2022 while the acts giving it tasks multiplied. The growth came from time-limited agreements with the Commission: in 2025 they paid 51 % of its revenue, and they run out in 2028. The Commission's proposal for a Cybersecurity Act 2 would turn much of that money into a permanent budget, but adds little on top, and its timing, the next EU budget and the fees are open.
stories.headline_de: Ist ENISA für ihre Aufgaben gerüstet? Die Hälfte ihres Geldes ist befristet, und der Cybersecurity Act 2 würde es vor allem verstetigen
stories.deck_de: ENISAs eigener Haushalt ist seit 2022 kaum gewachsen, während die Rechtsakte ihr Aufgabe um Aufgabe übertrugen. Das Wachstum kam aus befristeten Vereinbarungen mit der Kommission: 2025 trugen sie 51 % der Einnahmen, und sie laufen 2028 aus. Der Vorschlag der Kommission für einen Cybersecurity Act 2 würde viel davon in einen festen Haushalt überführen, legt aber wenig obenauf; Zeitpunkt, nächster EU-Haushalt und Gebühren sind offen.

stories.headline: EU Space Act: Regulation on the safety, resilience and sustainability of space activities in the Union …
stories.deck: Presidency compromise text on the EU Space Act of 29 October 2026, a clean version without change marks sent by the General Secretariat of the Council for the meeting of 3 November 2026; all delegations have a scrutiny reservation, so it is the Presidency's draft, not a Council position and not law, and it can still change.
stories.deck_de: Presidency compromise text on the EU Space Act of 29 October 2026, a clean version without change marks sent by the General Secretariat of the Council for the meeting of 3 November 2026; all delegations have a scrutiny reservation, so it is the Presidency's draft, not a Council position and not law, and it can still change.

brief.en: Compared with the clean text of March 2026, it adds market surveillance by Member States under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, lets a Member State self-certify spacecraft with substantial governmental involvement without a qualified technical body, narrows the obligation on space-based data to Earth observation data supplied to public contracting authorities and Union bodies (plus a landing-rights criterion for satellite communication), replaces the defence exclusions, and turns the environmental footprint into a life-cycle assessment with a standardisation request for the Union method. The cybersecurity provisions, which oblige space operators that are NIS-2 entities to follow the NIS-2 implementing act for space and apply equivalent measures to the other operators, and the incident reporting rules are unchanged apart from wording and corrected cross-references.
brief.de: Compared with the clean text of March 2026, it adds market surveillance by Member States under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, lets a Member State self-certify spacecraft with substantial governmental involvement without a qualified technical body, narrows the obligation on space-based data to Earth observation data supplied to public contracting authorities and Union bodies (plus a landing-rights criterion for satellite communication), replaces the defence exclusions, and turns the environmental footprint into a life-cycle assessment with a standardisation request for the Union method. The cybersecurity provisions, which oblige space operators that are NIS-2 entities to follow the NIS-2 implementing act for space and apply equivalent measures to the other operators, and the incident reporting rules are unchanged apart from wording and corrected cross-references.

stories.headline: The Regulation Desk now opens with what is new since the last edition, and says what a document contains
stories.deck: A story counts as new on the day it reaches the site, not on the date of its document; where we have reviewed a Council or Parliament document, its summary is the line under the headline; the edition is built after the morning check of the EU sources, and nothing appears twice.
stories.headline_de: Der Regulation Desk zeigt oben jetzt, was seit der letzten Ausgabe neu ist, und sagt, was in einem Dokument steht
stories.deck_de: Eine Meldung gilt an dem Tag als neu, an dem sie auf die Seite kommt, nicht am Datum ihres Dokuments; wo wir ein Dokument von Rat oder Parlament geprüft haben, steht seine Zusammenfassung unter der Schlagzeile; die Ausgabe entsteht nach der morgendlichen Prüfung der EU-Quellen, und nichts erscheint doppelt.
